chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from al-Mukhtar ibn Muhammad ibn al-Mukhtar and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Hasan al-'Alawi, all together from al-Fath ibn Yazid al-Jurjani, from Abi al-Hasan عليه السلام: concerning

About a man who killed his male slave or his female slave, he said: “If the enslaved person belonged to him, he is to be disciplined and imprisoned, unless he is known for killing slaves, in which case he is to be killed for him.”

key_terms.أُدِّبَ: he is disciplined or punished as a corrective legal measure
key_terms.فَيُقْتَلُ بِهِ: then he is killed in retribution for him
key_terms.مَعْرُوفًا: known or recognized publicly for such conduct
key_terms.مَمْلُوكَتَهُ: his female slave; an enslaved woman owned by him
key_terms.مَمْلُوكَهُ: his male slave; an enslaved person owned by him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills his own slave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a master who kills his own male or female slave. The ruling states that he is disciplined and imprisoned, but if he is known for repeatedly killing slaves, then qiṣāṣ is carried out against him.
